_comment: Sentinel probe: the busybox userland installed by guest-init (busybox --install -s /bin) provides sh, cat and grep, and a real pipeline works. This is the minimum toolbox every other probe's commandLine assumes.

process.commandLine: missing=0; for t in sh cat grep; do if ! command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "TOOL_MISSING_BUG $t"; missing=1; fi; done; if [ "$missing" = 0 ]; then echo TOOLS_PRESENT_OK; fi; if echo pipeline-payload-77 | cat | grep -q pipeline-payload-77; then echo USERLAND_OK; else echo USERLAND_BUG; fi
